Key features 
Specifications 
Standards 
Compatible instruments 
Measure various samples with a range of different dispersion units: Liquid Flow, Liquid Flow Imaging, Small Flow, Small Flow Imaging, Liquid Flow Chemical, Liquid Flow Imaging Chemical, Dry Jet, and Free Fall. Switch between dispersion units with the Quick-Click feature in just one move – no need for any extra cables, tubes, or pipes. 
Welcome to particle analysis at the touch of a button.
Key features
Absolute operator safety
Safety cover prevents toxic or explosive sample spread
Liquid level recognition before sonication prevents overheating
All toxic or explosive samples contained
Automated dispersion units
Automated filling, draining, and rinsing of dispersion liquid
Optimal sample feeding rate set automatically
Wide range of powerful dispersion units
Liquid Flow offers sample dispersion in a carrier liquid, while Liquid Flow Chemical adds high chemical resistance for handling aggressive liquids.
Small Flow is a chemically resistant liquid dispersion unit, that minimizes the required liquid volume and sample amount.
All liquid dispersion units are available with integrated Imaging unit, which allows combination of laser diffraction with dynamic image analysis.
Dry Jet dispersion unit uses compressed air to disperse agglomerates of dry samples, while Free Fall (available for Litesizer DIA series) uses gravitational fall to disperse dry free-flowing materials.

Your data may be transferred to the USA which does not have a data protection level comparable to GDPR. In this case your data may potentially be accessed by US Authorities for surveillance purposes and you may not be able to exercise effective legal remedies. You can accept or reject all cookies by clicking on the respective button or define your cookie settings using the link "Customize your cookie settings".
If you reject all cookies, only technically required cookies will be used. You can also withdraw your consent at a later time by accessing the Cookie Settings.
